listNote: The official 55-trophy list as PlayStation publishes it, frozen 18 November 2026 from Exophase and cross-checked against PSNProfiles: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 of them hidden until earned. Names, descriptions and grades are the official ones; every guide below is written for this page in its own words, and each one names the source its facts come from.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum lands the moment the other 54 are yours — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work the roadmap's three stages in order and this one pops with the last trophy you earn.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: A story trophy, earned automatically: play through Gone Fishing, the mission that opens the game, and it unlocks as the mission ends. Nothing here can be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: A story trophy: finish Chapter 1 and it unlocks. Before you wrap the chapter up, meditate at Jason's house — that first meditation spot is the one thing in the whole set that can pass you by for good.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: A story trophy: finish Chapter 2 and it unlocks. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter — there is no mission replay, so a save is your only way back.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: A story trophy: finish Chapter 3. Nothing to prepare; just play the chapter through.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: A story trophy: finish Chapter 4. You are most of the way through the story by now — the final mission follows.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: A story trophy, and a gold one: finish the final mission. Save by hand before you start it — there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so this is your last easy chance to tidy anything up.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: A story trophy: finish the mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks as the mission ends.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: A story trophy: finish the mission The Cartel Heist.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: A story trophy: finish the mission Child's Play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: A story trophy: finish the mission Headliners.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: A story trophy: finish the mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: A story trophy: finish the mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% Completion — the gold that takes the longest. The checklist itself (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion) only appears once the story is done, but everything you did earlier already counts and nothing on it is missable. PowerPyx calls it the hardest trophy in the set and puts it at about 60% of true completion; most of it falls out of the other trophies, so chase it in Stage 2 after the story.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts of any kind. Leonida holds 397 in total — 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights and 25 Base Jumps — so any 250 will do, though the 100% checklist asks for 300. Fold stunt jumps into city driving and bridge fly-unders into flights between jobs.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every activity type once — nine in total. Sample each one as the story introduces it: races, fishing, arcade games, bowling, the shooting range, drone races, meditation, hunting and challenges.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold every one of the 42 Shooting Range challenges. The golds are not punishing, per PowerPyx, and each one also counts toward the 70-of-80 challenges the 100% checklist wants.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations. Every race can be retried, so learn a course, then win it, one location at a time.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Street, off-road, boat and air races each count as different races, so enter whatever you come across around Leonida.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Track Cal down, take the challenge, and retry it until you win — fishing challenges can be repeated.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play any arcade game through to the end. Pick the shortest one you can find and finish it.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand — the trophy pops when his final mission is done. Pick stranger strands up as they appear during the story rather than leaving them all for later.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand; the trophy unlocks with his final mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand; the trophy unlocks with his final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands anywhere in Leonida. Take stranger missions as you find them while exploring and see each strand through to its last mission.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand; the trophy unlocks with his final mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand; the trophy unlocks with his final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots, spread over 10 locations, as both Jason and Lucia. This is the set's only trophy that can be missed for good: the first meditation is offered at Jason's house in Chapter 1 and is gone once that chapter ends, so meditate there before you finish Chapter 1, then sweep the remaining spots as you travel.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Take Bret's hunt, track the animal he names, and study wildlife with binoculars along the way — the 100% checklist also wants 100 of 255 animals studied.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Finish any 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards turn up all over Leonida; finish three sets and the silver is yours. Community maps are still being filled in during launch week, so check the source links for the latest.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 different locations. Each spot counts once, so keep moving around the map instead of repeating the same place.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish 50 Challenges. Challenges pile up from races, stunts, shooting and more; keep going past 50, because the 100% checklist wants 70 of 80.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and get away. Break line of sight, stay out of view, and wait for the heat to die down.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops one after another without ever losing your wanted level. Plan a route of shops close together and keep a fast car ready for the getaway.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — every new model you drive or come across counts. Keep discovering past 100: the 100% checklist wants 200 of 277 base models scanned.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies inside a single Combat Focus. Start it in a busy firefight with a group in front of you and drop five before it runs out.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave VCIA on your own schedule — take a plane out of the airport yourself instead of flying as a passenger.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank and drive away with it. Tanks sit in the open at military spots; grab one and go, and expect a 3-star wanted level on your tail.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being spotted. Go in quiet, keep the alarms silent, leave no witnesses, and get out clean.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Sort your escape route before you go in — the getaway matters as much as the robbery.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush the truck, take the cash, then shake the wanted level.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Visit all 52 areas of Leonida. Areas tick off as you travel through them, so a full sweep of the map does it.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs. Nine gangs, nine robberies — find an operation belonging to each and hit it.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: The description points to a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — try the beach bars there. Honest note: at launch, PowerPyx had not yet pinned down the exact trigger for this one, so check the roadmap link for updates as players work it out.
trophies.source: Official list · PowerPyx roadmap (method not yet known at launch)

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The description suggests smashing your way out of a vehicle showroom. Honest note: at launch, PowerPyx had not yet pinned down the exact trigger, so check the roadmap link for updates as players work it out.
trophies.source: Official list · PowerPyx roadmap (method not yet known at launch)

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through on your shots. A full game there should do it.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partner moment — the description hints at a partnership with mass appeal. No published source names the exact trigger yet; play the story with your partner and it should pop at the right beat.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices across the game, for better or worse. The trophy tracks the choices you make; no published count exists yet, so keep choosing as you play.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The name hints at succeeding on a second try. Honest note: at launch, PowerPyx had not yet pinned down the exact trigger, so check the roadmap link for updates as players work it out.
trophies.source: Official list · PowerPyx roadmap (method not yet known at launch)

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The name points to a strange encounter somewhere in Leonida. Honest note: at launch, PowerPyx had not yet pinned down the exact trigger, so check the roadmap link for updates as players work it out.
trophies.source: Official list · PowerPyx roadmap (method not yet known at launch)

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The name suggests knocking someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Honest note: at launch, PowerPyx had not yet pinned down the exact trigger, so check the roadmap link for updates as players work it out.
trophies.source: Official list · PowerPyx roadmap (method not yet known at launch)

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. It adds up across the whole game, so hand bills over whenever you have them.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total accumulates, so normal shopping across the game gets you there.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties on the map.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles through the Scooter Bros app — vehicles you own or find.
